summary: Iteration 6 - Backend testing of 2 new features: (1) memberFieldLabel default per association type + admin edit via PUT /api/auth/association-settings, (2) PUT /api/years/:id supports updating the year number with uniqueness check and preserves payments. 12/12 pytest cases PASS (100%).

review_scope_validation.1_amicale_default_fonction: PASS - POST /api/platform/associations {type:'amicale'} returns association with memberFieldLabel='Fonction' (verified via creation response AND GET /api/platform/associations/:id).
review_scope_validation.3_association_default_fonction: PASS - type 'association' also defaults to 'Fonction' (as per platform.js lines 333-337: association OR amicale → Fonction).
review_scope_validation.4_admin_can_edit_label: PASS - PUT /api/auth/association-settings with {memberFieldLabel:'Matricule'} by ADMIN → 200; GET /api/auth/association-settings echoes customFieldLabel='Matricule'.
review_scope_validation.5_reject_empty_label: PASS - Empty string and whitespace-only string → 400 with error 'Le libellé ne peut pas être vide'.
review_scope_validation.6_reject_non_admin: PASS - MEMBER role (created via /api/members, logged in via accessToken) → PUT rejected with 403 'Accès réservé aux administrateurs'.
review_scope_validation.8_update_year_number: PASS - PUT /api/years/:id with {year:2045} updates the year and persists across GET /api/years.
review_scope_validation.9_reject_duplicate_year: PASS - Attempt to update year to a value already used in the same association → 400 'Cette année existe déjà pour cette association'.
review_scope_validation.10_reject_invalid_year_range: PASS - PUT with year=1500 or year=2200 → 400 'Numéro d'année invalide' (range enforced 2000-2100).
review_scope_validation.11_payments_persist_after_rename: PASS - After renaming a year (2035 → 2091), GET /api/payments/year/:yearId still returns the payment (id, memberId, yearId, month=3, amountPaid=10000) attached; only the year number label is updated. yearId remains stable so all foreign keys (payments) remain attached.

minor.issue: Year range restricted to 2000-2100 in UPDATE but POST /api/years accepts any integer. This asymmetry means an admin who created a year like 3000 via POST cannot later rename it via PUT (validation blocks). Consider aligning validation between POST and PUT (either both enforce, or PUT allows any int).

critical_code_review_comments: platform.js POST /associations correctly maps type→default label: amicale/association → 'Fonction', syndicat/syndic/copropriété → 'Villa'. Type comparison is case-insensitive (lowercased). Good defensive default: unknown types fall back to 'Villa'.

auth.js PUT /api/auth/association-settings: uses req.user.role check for ADMIN. Correctly trims label and rejects empty. Uses req.associationId (attached by authenticateToken middleware) so tenant isolation is preserved.

years.js PUT /:id: proper tenant scoping (findFirst with associationId filter), uniqueness check excluding current id, range validation 2000-2100. Payments remain attached because yearId (UUID) is untouched — only the numeric 'year' column is modified.

Suggestion: platform.js PUT /api/platform/associations/:id also accepts memberFieldLabel — but there is no empty-string guard here (unlike auth.js PUT). If a SUPER_ADMIN passes memberFieldLabel:'', the '&& { memberFieldLabel }' short-circuit will skip it (falsy), so it's safe. But whitespace-only strings WOULD be persisted since only truthy check is applied. Minor consistency concern.

Suggestion: auth.js GET /api/auth/association-settings hard-codes fallback to 'Villa' in the catch block (line 173) — this could confuse an amicale admin if the DB read ever fails. Prefer returning a 500 or the real default per type.
